historical_references.reference: Ayushi was a name of Ahalya, the wife of the sage Gautama. She was cursed by the sage Agastya and transformed into a stone. Later, when Rishi Gautama was meditating, Ayushi was brought back to life by Lord Indra and named Ayushi because she was given back her life (Ayu = life).

Ayushi was a daughter of King Vibhishana of Lanka and his queen Tilottama. She was brought up in the care of sage Valmiki and was a great devotee of Lord Rama. Ayushi played a crucial role in the war between Rama and Ravana, during which she was killed by Ravana's son Indrajit. After her death, Rama performed her last rites and honored her sacrifice by giving her a celestial body.
